MATCH (owner1 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner2 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]-(owner2)
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
WITH a1, a2,
     CASE WHEN a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no THEN a1.acct_no ELSE a2.acct_no END AS acct_no1,
     CASE WHEN a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no THEN a2.acct_no ELSE a1.acct_no END AS acct_no2
RETURN DISTINCT acct_no1, acct_no2
ORDER BY acct_no1, acct_no2
LIMIT $limit

calls.question: Find accounts that have received transfers from more than 100 distinct sending accounts, returning the five smallest account numbers in ascending order.
calls.cypher:
MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(receiver:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH receiver, count(DISTINCT sender) AS senderCount
WHERE senderCount > $ws
RETURN receiver.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY receiver.acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

calls.question: How many accounts have received transfers from more than 100 distinct sending accounts?
calls.cypher:
MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(receiver:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH receiver, count(DISTINCT sender) AS senderCount
WHERE senderCount > $ws
RETURN receiver.id AS accountId, receiver.acct_no AS acctNo, senderCount
ORDER BY senderCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

calls.question: List accounts that have received transfers from at least 101 distinct sending accounts, returning the five smallest account numbers in ascending order.
calls.cypher:
MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(receiver:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH receiver, count(DISTINCT sender) AS distinct_senders
WHERE distinct_senders >= $ws
RETURN receiver.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit
